items.followUp: State one difference between somatic cells and germ-line cells based on how they divide.

rubric.why: Checks the identity or usual mode of division of somatic cells.
rubric.description: Identifies somatic cells as body cells, or states that they usually divide by mitosis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for either key point.

rubric.why: Checks the role or usual mode of division of germ-line cells.
rubric.description: States that germ-line cells give rise to gametes, usually through meiosis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for either key point.

modelAnswer: Somatic cells are body cells other than germ-line cells; they usually divide by mitosis.
Germ-line cells give rise to gametes, usually through meiosis.

items.followUp: Write the balanced chemical equation for cellular respiration.

rubric.why: Checks that the equation has the correct balanced reactants and products.
rubric.description: Writes the balanced chemical equation for photosynthesis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including all four substances in their correct positions.

rubric.why: Checks that the conditions shown for photosynthesis are correct.
rubric.description: Shows sunlight and chlorophyll over or beside the reaction arrow.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including both sunlight and chlorophyll.

items.followUp: What is activation energy, and how does an enzyme affect it?

rubric.why: Checks the mechanism by which an enzyme helps a reaction proceed.
rubric.description: States that an enzyme forms an enzyme-substrate complex or provides an alternative pathway.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for either key mechanism.

rubric.why: Checks the effect of the enzyme on the reaction's energy barrier.
rubric.description: States that enzymes lower the activation energy needed for the reaction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explicitly stating that activation energy is reduced.

modelAnswer: An enzyme binds its substrate to form an enzyme substrate complex and provides a pathway with a lower energy barrier.
Thus, less activation energy is needed for the reaction to occur.
